ValidationRule.description: Delta to cap off hours and increase cap projects require the "made offer" field
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR( ISPICKVAL( Project__c , "Delta to Cap off Hours"), ISPICKVAL( Project__c, "Increase Cap")), ISPICKVAL( Status , "Closed"), ISPICKVAL( Made_Offer__c , ""))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Made Offer Field Required for this project Case
